question.text: Kaveri Macro Fund (Cat III AIF) has NAV of INR 300 crore. The CIO wants to take aggressive directional bets. What is the MAXIMUM gross notional exposure the fund can take under SEBI Cat III leverage rules?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI (AIF) Regulations cap Category III AIF leverage at 2x of NAV. Therefore max gross exposure = 2 * 300 = INR 600 crore. Cat I/II have ZERO leverage (except short-term borrowings for operational reasons). The Trap: Option A is the Cat I/II zero-leverage rule — wrong category. Option B (1.5x) is a half-remembered limit. Option D (3x) is NOT permitted for Indian Cat III AIFs. Note: SEBI applies continuous monitoring to the 2x exposure/NAV cap. If the cap is breached, the source requires next-working-day reporting and square-off rather than an intraday allowance.
